title: Creamy Mushroom, Rosemary & Pea Orzotto
description: Chestnut mushrooms and orzo pasta simmered risotto-style with rosemary, garlic and white wine, finished with peas and a spoonful of crème fraîche.
ingredients: 1 tbsp very finely chopped rosemary leaves
steps: Spray sauté pan with cooking spray; fry onion and mushrooms over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add garlic and rosemary; stir-fry 30 seconds. Tip in orzo; stir-fry 1 minute.
Increase heat to high; pour in wine; stir; then pour in 700ml of the stock.
Rapid simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add frozen peas and remaining stock.
Simmer 5 more minutes, stirring continuously until orzo is tender. Season and stir in crème fraîche.
Serve immediately with a little more chopped rosemary.
notes: Smoked bacon pieces fried with the onions and mushrooms make a tasty meat addition.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
